rationale: Gate 1 paper-feasibility criteria (Q38, Q62) for candidate declarations. Hard pass/fail items only; no scoring. Every numeric value is either exact from a prior decision (status evidence) or a numerical tolerance or count labeled provisional. Thresholds that lack evidence are marked unresolved and carry no number. Results are labeled exploratory and never validated_acceptance.

max_diameter_um.basis: Q12: common 60 mm enclosing sphere in the mechanically achievable stowed configuration (exact)

uncertain_band_um.basis: double-precision rounding margin only; a computed diameter within this band of the limit is unresolved

round_rim_points.basis: Welzl seed points per cylinder rim; the certified radius is computed exactly, so this affects only the seed centre

sphere_seed_directions.basis: Welzl seed points per sphere primitive (face, edge and corner directions); certification is exact

interference_erosion_um.basis: each convex shape is eroded by this amount before the intersection test, so touching surfaces and rounding do not count as interference

min_clearance_um.basis: pure geometric non-overlap; no clearance requirement is invented here

containment_tolerance_um.basis: double-precision rounding margin for the inside test

intersection_algorithm.basis: protocol section 4; deterministic fixed start direction and iteration cap

gjk_iteration_cap.basis: reaching the cap makes the item unresolved

assembly_access_statement_min_chars.basis: the requirement is presence of a statement; its substance is reviewed at the gate record, not computed

allowed_bases.basis: estimate is not allowed to pass; it makes the item unresolved

mass_sum_tolerance_mg.basis: integer milligram arithmetic, so the sum is exact

derived_mass_tolerance_mg.basis: allows the rounding of density times volume to an integer milligram

peak_power_rule.basis: worst case, all components at peak at once; no exclusivity credit is given at Gate 1

exactly_one_energy_source.basis: Gate 1 budgets a single declared source; multi-source layouts need a superseding record

threshold.reason: Q31 task duration is not decided, so no endurance threshold exists; the value is reported and never gates

items.title: Coupler layout supports a connected tabletop chain

min_coupler_sites.basis: a chain unit needs a distinct site on each side (Q31)

chain_units.basis: minimal chain with an interior unit using both sites; Q31's benchmark uses five

contact_tolerance_um.basis: a point within this height of the tabletop plane counts as touching it

support_rule.basis: static support on a flat tabletop (Q21); zero-area contact cannot pass

tabletop_penetration_tolerance_um.basis: same value as the contact tolerance

requires_power_to_hold.basis: Q11, CPL-009: structural retention is passive when unpowered

magnetism_requires_declared_component.basis: Q36, CPL-005: magnetic attraction is not assumed

justification_record_path_pattern.basis: protocol section 8; independent reviewer, outcome pass, fail or unresolved

forbidden_reference_classes.basis: Q61 section 1; F1 is the Big Hero 6 microbots
